tgt: Lolu hambo luphinde lwakhulisa amandla iNingizimu Afrika enawo ukwakha ingqalasizinda esophe amathuba azotholwa yizinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika embukisweni i-EXPO 2020 ozobe ubanjelwe eDubai, kanjalo nokusebenza ngokubambisana emkhakheni wezoxolo, ukuvikeleka kanye nozinzo.

src: The visit also promoted South African infrastructure building capacity targeting opportunities for South African companies at EXPO 2020 in Dubai, as well as cooperation in the field of peace, security and stability.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamukelile izinyathelo eziqinile ezibekwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezemidlalo Nokungcebeleka uFikile Mbalula ukubumba kabusha ukubukeka kwesimo sezemidlalo nokungcebeleka esiqhekekile nesibandlululayo ngendlela ejulile esebenzisa uMqulu waso Woguquko.

src: Cabinet welcomed the firm measures that have been put in place by the Minister of Sport and Recreation Fikile Mbalula to reconstruct the fragmented and deeply discriminatory sport and recreation landscape through its Transformation Charter.
tgt: Lokhu kuzodlondlobalisa uguquko maqondana nohlelo lwezemidlalo olubumbene olusekelwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yentando yeningi labantu, ukulingana, ukusebenzela obala, ukumeleleka kwabantu ngokwehlukahlukana kwabo, ukufinyeleleka kanye nokubamba iqhaza okukhuphukile ngokuhambelana nezinjongo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Cabinet welcomes the budget votes being presented by various departments with extensive reports outlining the progress made towards improving the lives of South Africans.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izinkulumo zamavoti esabiwomali ezethulwa yiminyango eyehlukene ezihambisana nemibiko ebanzi eqhakambisa inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokwenziwa ngcono kwezimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: This demonstrates implementation of the Medium Term Strategic Framework which takes us closer to the realisation of Vision 2030 of the National Development Plan.
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ukuqaliswa ukusebenza koHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi olusisondeza eduzane nokufezekiswa koMbono wezi-2030 woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Cabinet calls on South Africans to follow the budget votes on various media platforms to better understand Government’s Programme of Action.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba balandelele izinkulumo zokwabiwa kwezimali ezinkundleni zabenzindaba ezinhlobonhlobo ukuze baqonde kangcono ngoHlelo Lokusebenza lukaHulumeni.

src: Cabinet calls for continued commitment to secure meaningful workplace transformation in view of the findings from the 16th Commission for Employment Equity Annual Report for all designated employers which was launched under the theme “Transformation does make business sense”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa ukuba kube khona ukuzibophezela okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvikelwe uguquko olunengqondo lwendawo yokusebenzela ngokubhekelela imiphumela evela Embikweni Wonyaka weKhomishana ye-16 Yokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana wabo bonke abaqashi abaqokiwe owethulwa ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Uguquko lubalulekile”.

src: The Report helps government to understand the status of employment equity in the country and its progress in workplace transformation for the year 2015.
tgt: Umbiko usiza uhulumeni ukuba aqonde isimo sokuqashwa kwabantu ngokulingana ezweni kanye nenqubekelaphambili yaso ekuguqulweni kwendawo yokusebenzela onyakeni wezi-2015.

src: Cabinet congratulated the Department of Human Settlements on the delivery of 4, 3 million houses and housing opportunities since the dawn of democracy.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu ngokwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyizigidi eziwu-4, 3 kanye namathuba okwakhiwa kwenzindlu kusukela kwafika umbuso wentando yeningi labantu.

src: These opportunities include 2, 806 235 fully subsidized houses (BNG houses), 121 784 social/rental housing, 6329 Financial Linked Individual Subsidy Programme and 986 608 serviced sites.
tgt: Lawa mathuba abandakanya izindlu ezixhaswe ngokuphelele eziyizi-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zomphakathi/eziqashisayo eziyizi-121 784, izi-6329 zoHlelo Lokuxhaswa Komuntu Ngamunye Oluxhunywe Kwezezimali kanye neziza zokwakha ezinezinsizakalo eziyizi-986 608.Leli banga eliyingqophamlando eselihanjiwe selihlinzeke umpheme kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kanti-ke ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo umnyango sewethule umkhankaso kazwelonke wokudweba isithombe sempumelelo yezwe lakithi.

src: This historic milestone has provided a roof for more than 20 million people and to celebrate this achievement the department has launched a national campaign to profile the country’s success.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kukazwelonke kubanjelwe e-COSMO City, okungomunye wemiklamo yezindlu edidiyelwe eseqhulwini ezweni lonkana nawo ogubha iminyaka eyishumi ukhona.

src: The national launch took place in COSMO City, one of the integrated priority projects around the country which is also celebrating ten years of its existence.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngegalelo labo, ukuzimisela kanye nokusebenza kanzima ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi isithunzi sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaswele siyabuyiselwa ngezinhlelo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu.

src: Cabinet thanked all South Africans for their contributions, dedication and hard work in ensuring that the dignity of South Africans in need is restored through human settlements.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income uNobhala-Jikelele weNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangane ngokuhlanganisa Umcimbi Osezingeni Eliphezulu Wokucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris, esamukelwa ngamazwe ayi-176 ngoZibandlela wezi-2015.

src: The signing of the Paris Agreement marked the first step in its implementation which will guide international efforts to limit greenhouse gas emissions and to meet all the associated challenges posed by climate change.
tgt: Ukucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris kuwuphawu lwesinyathelo sokuqala ekuqalisweni kokusebenza kwaso okuzohola imizamo yamazwe omhlaba ukunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwezintuthu ezingcolisa umoya kanye nokuhlangabezana nazo zonke izinselele eziphonswe ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: Cabinet looks forward to the conclusion of the respective domestic ratification procedures, by all, to enable timely entry into force for full implementation of the Paris Agreement by 2020.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isilangazelele isiphetho sezinqubo zezigunyazo zalapha ezweni ngaphakathi ezihlukahlukene, yibo bonke abantu, ukuvumela ukuqaliswa ngesikhathi kokusebenza ngokuphelele Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris ngowezi-2020.

src: Cabinet also notes that the Department of Environmental Affairs has partnered with the Department of Tourism in convening delivery labs titled “Biodiversity Lab: Growing the economic contribution of South Africa’s biological resources” from 10 April to 13 May 2016.The aim is to realise the economic potential of South Africa’s rich biological diversity which is articulated in the draft National Biodiversity Economy Strategy that was approved by Cabinet in July 2015 for public participation.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqaphela ukuthi uMnyango Wezemvelo usubambisene noMnyango Wezokuvakasha ekuhlanganiseni amalebhu okuhanjiswa kwezinsizakalo abizwa ngokuthi yi-“Biodiversity Lab: Ukukhulisa igalelo lezomnotho lemithombo yezemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika” kusukela mhla ziyi-10 kuMbasa kuya mhla ziyi-13 kuNhlaba 2016.Inhloso ukufezekisa amandla ezomnotho emvelo enothile yaseNingizimu Afrika eyingxubevange aveziwe ohlakeni lokuqala lweQhinga Likazwelonke Lezomnotho Yezemvelo Eyingxubevange olwagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi ngoNtulikazi wezi-2015 ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukubamba iqhaza kulona.

src: Key Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Cabinet approved the Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) 2016/17 – 2018/19, which is a key pillar of the President’s Nine-Point Plan and contributes towards implementation of the National Development Plan.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlelo Lokusebenza Lwenqubomgomo Yezimboni (i-IPAP) lowezi-2016/17 – 2018/19, oluyinsika eqavile yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye lukaMongameli futhi olunegalelo maqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: This is the eighth annual iteration of successive government industrialisation plans which builds on the achievements, policy platforms and programmes of previous iterations.
tgt: Lesi yisibuyekezo sonyaka wesishiyagalombili sezinhlelo eziyimpumelelo zezimboni zikahulumeni esakhela ezinzuzweni, izithangami zezinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo zezibuyekezo ezidlulile.

src: IPAP 2016/17 seeks to achieve a higher impact industrial policy in difficult economic circumstances.
tgt: I-IPAP yowezi-2016/17 ifuna ukuzuza inqubomgomo yezezimboni enomthelela ophezulu ezimweni ezinzima zezomnotho.

src: These include the on-going effects of the global economic recession including the steel crisis and commodity slump as well as the severe drought and other significant domestic constraints.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya imithelela eqhubekayo yokuwohloka kwamandla omnotho emhlabeni wonke kubandakanya nesimo esimazonzo embonini yezensimbi nezimbiwaphansi kanjalo nesomiso esibi kakhulu kanye nezinye izingqinamba ezinkulu ezikhona ezweni lakithi ngaphakathi.

src: Achievements from the previous year include the saving of approximately 67 000 jobs and the creation of an estimated 7 000 new decent jobs in the Clothing and Textile Leather and Footwear sector.
tgt: Izimpumelelo zangonyaka odlule zibandakanya ukuphephiswa kwemisebenzi ebalelwa ezi-67 000 kanye nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi eqotho emisha sha eyizi-7 000 emkhakheni Wezendwangu, Izimpahla Zesikhumba kanye Nezicathulo.

src: The Agro-processing sub-sector is one of the largest domestic manufacturing sectors by employment, providing an estimated 216 090 jobs in 2015 compared to 208 822 in 2014.
tgt: Umkhakhana ongaphansi kwezokukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo ungomunye wemikhakha emikhulukazi lapha ezweni yezokukhiqiza ngokuqasha abantu, ngokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi elinganiselwa ezi-216 090 ngowezi-2015 uma kuqhathaniswa nezi-208 822 ngowezi-2014.

src: Over R600 million worth of investment was attracted in 2015/16, laying the basis for strengthening enterprise development with a focus on rural communities.
tgt: Izigidi ezingaphezu kwama-600 zamarandi zotshalomali ezihehekile ngowezi-2015/16, ezindlale isisekelo sokuqinisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi ngokugxila kakhulu emiphakathini yasezindaweni ezisemakhaya.

src: Cabinet approved the Final Integrated Urban Development Framework and 2016/19 Implementation Plan.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlaka Lokusebenza Lokugcina Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe kanye Nohlelo Lokuqaliswa Ukusebenza lowezi-2016/19.

src: The overall outcome of the Integrated Urban Development Framework is spatial transformation.
tgt: Umphumela ophelele woHlaka Lokusebenza Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe ukuguqulwa kokuklaywa kwemingcele yedolobha.

src: This marks a new deal for South African cities and towns, which will steer urban growth towards a sustainable growth model of compact, connected and coordinated cities and towns, which are safer, resource efficient and good places to work and live in.
tgt: Lokhu kuwuphawu lesivumelwano esisha samadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane aseNingizimu Afrika, esizoqhubezela phambili ukukhula kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni siziqhubekisele ohlakeni lokukhula okuqinile kwamadolobha namadolobhana amancane ahlangene, axhumene futhi adidiyelwe, aphephile, anezinsiza ezanele futhi ayizindawo ezinhle zokusebenza kanye nokuhlala kuzo.

src: This responds to the National Development Plan directive to develop an urban development policy that will ensure proper planning, infrastructure investments and management to support growth and unlock the economic potential of our cities and towns.
tgt: Lokhu kuphendula emyalelweni woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe wokuthi kusungulwe inqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni ezoqinisekisa ukuhlela okufanelekile, utshalomali lwezingqalasizinda kanye nokuphathwa kwalo ukuze kwesekwe ukukhula kanye nokuthukulula amandla ezomnotho amadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane ethu.

src: Cabinet approved publication of the Draft National Career Development Services Policy – Building an effective and Integrated Career Development Services System for South Africa, in the Government Gazette for public comment.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa koHlaka lweNqubomgomo Yezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Kazwelonke – Ukwakha Uhlelo Lwezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Oluyimpumelelo Noludidiyelwe lwaseNingizimu Afrika, eMqulwini Kahulumeni ukuze kutholwe imibono yomphakathi.

src: The draft Policy once implemented will provide a coordinated approach to quality career development services for all citizens.
tgt: Uhlaka lweNqubomgomo uma seluqalisiwe ukusebenza luzohlinzeka ngendlela yokusebenza ehlanganisiwe yezinsizakalo zokuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yemisebenzi eziseqophelweni eliphezulu zazo zonke izakhamuzi.

src: This will enable them to make informed career choices to obtain employment, contribute to society and build the South African WEBTOKEN Development Services plays a key role in helping labour markets work and education systems meet their goals.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukukhetha imikhakha yemisebenzi ngomqondo ophusile ukuze zikwazi ukuqashwa, zibe negalelo emphakathini futhi zakhe umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: This contributes towards the achievement of the National Development Plan recommendations of promoting economic growth and employment, matching of employed workers to jobs and increasing skills development and the number of university graduates.
tgt: Izinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi zidlala indima esemqoka ekusizeni umsebenzi wezimakethe zabasebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinjongo zazo.

src: Cabinet was briefed on implementation of the National Evaluation System and approved the Annual report 2014/15 and the fifth National Evaluation Plan for 2016/17 to 2018/19, as part of the drive to improve service delivery,The National Evaluation System emanates from the National Evaluation Policy Framework which ensures that credible and objective evidence from evaluations is incorporated in processes of planning, budgeting, organisational improvement, policy review, as well as on-going programme and project management so as to improve performance.
tgt: Lokhu kunegalelo maqondana nokufezekiswa kwezincomo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe zokugqugquzela ukukhula komnotho kanye nokuqashwa kwabantu, ukuqondaniswa kwabasebenzi abaqashiwe nemisebenzi yabo kanye nokwandisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nesibalo sabantu abaneziqu zemfundo yasenyuvesi.

src: Forty-seven (47) evaluations have been completed or are underway, covering R75 billion of government expenditure.
tgt: Izilinganiso ezingama-47 seziphothuliwe noma zisaqhutshwa, ezikhava izigidigidi ezingama-75 zamarandi ezindleko zikahulumeni.

src: Fifteen (15) evaluation reports were approved and 12 tabled at Cabinet to date.
tgt: Imibiko yokulinganisa eyi-15 yagunyazwa kwathi eyi-12 yabekwa ezithebeni zeKhabhinethi kuze kube manje.

src: Fourteen (14) improvement plans are being implemented and progress on these reflects substantial changes, to widen impact.
tgt: Izinhlelo zokwenza ngcono eziyi-14 ziyaqaliswa ukusebenza kanti futhi inqubekelaphambili maqondana nazo ikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu kakhulu, ukukhulisa umthelela wazo.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the evaluation findings and approved recommendations with a view to increase impact from the implementation of the Expanded Public Works Programme Social Sector (EPWP-SS).This Programme plays an important social protection role for unemployed able bodied adults, by drawing them into productive work and receiving a monthly stipend of an average amount of R1 517.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yokulinganisa kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe ngenhloso yokwandisa umthelela osukela ekuqalisweni ukusebenza Kohlelo Lemisebenzi Yomphakathi Eyandisiwe Yomkhakha Wezenhlalo (i-EPWP-SS).Lolu Hlelo ludlala indima esemqoka yokuvikelwa kwesimo senhlalo yabantu abantu abangakhubazeke ndawo abangasebenzi, kokubadonsela emsebenzini onomkhiqizo bese bethola umthobanhlizinyo njalo ngenyanga olinganiselwa esambeni se-R1 517.

src: Most of the social sector programmes provide specialised services to vulnerable and poor communities.
tgt: Iningi lezinhlelo zomkhakha wezenhlalo lihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhethekile emiphakathini entekenteke nehluphekayo.

src: The EPWP-SS grew rapidly between phase one and phase two, from 5 to 22 programmes which resulted in the sector achieving 175 769 work opportunities in phase one and 866 246 work opportunities in phase two, well above the 750 000 target.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngesivinini esikhulu phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibili, kusukela ezinhlelweni ezi-5 kuya ezinhlelweni ezingama-22 okuholele kulo mkhakha ukuba ufezekise amathuba emisebenzi ayizi-175 769 esigabeni sokuqala kanye namathuba emisebenzi ayizi-866 246 esigabeni sesibili, nokungaphezulu kakhulu kobekusophiwe okungamathuba emisebenzi ayizi-750 000.Izincomo zigxile ekwenzeni ngcono ukuqaliswa kokusebenza ukuze kuncishiswe ukungasebenzi ngendlela egculisayo ekuthathweni kwezinqumo, ukuqaliswa ukusebenza (izinkokhelo zemithobanhliziyo) kanye nokuhlinzekwa ngokuqeqesha, kanjalo nokuxhumanisa.

src: The recommendations focus on improving implementation to reduce inefficiencies in decision-making, implementation (payments of stipends) and provision of training, as well as coordination.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe zedizayini kanye nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kokulinganiswa Kwesabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni kanye Nohlelo Lokwenziwa Ngcono kwaso.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings and endorsed the recommendations of the design and implementation evaluation of the Urban Settlement Development Grant and its Improvement Plan.
tgt: Imiphumela yeseka ukugcinwa kweSabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni njengesabelo sokunezezela esikhokhela umqondo ovulekile wokuhlaliswa kwabantu okuqhubekayo nokulinganayo ukuze kuhlomule abantu abahluphekayo kanye namakhaya anemali engenayo engenkulu kakhulu.

src: The findings support retaining the Urban Settlement Development Grant as a supplementary grant that funds a wider notion of sustainable and equitable human settlements for the benefit of poor and moderate income households.
tgt: Lokhu kuwusizo kakhulu ekufezekiseni izinjongo zoHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwamathuba okwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyisigidi esi-1 495 ezindaweni zokuhlala eziseqophelweni eliphezulu ngowezi-2019.

src: Cabinet approved the report on the Implementation and Impact Evaluation of the Technology and Human Resources for Industry Programme, the management response to the report and the improvement plan submitted by the Department of Trade and Industry.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze umbiko maqondana Nokuqaliswa Ukusebenza kanye Nokulinganiswa Komthelela Wezobuchwepheshe kanye Nezindaba Zabasebenzi zoHlelo Lwezezimboni, impendulo yabaphathi embikweni kanye nohlelo lokwenza ngcono oluthunyelwe nguMnyango Wezokuhwebelana kanye Nezezimboni.

src: This Programme was introduced by the Department of Trade and Industry in 1992 to strengthen skills development in science, engineering and technology.
tgt: Lolu Hlelo lwethulwa nguMnyango Wezohwebo kanye Nezezimboni ngowe-1992 ukuze kuqiniswe ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kwezesayensi, ezobunjiniyela kanye nezobuchwepheshe.

src: It contributes to job creation by producing a flow of highly skilled researchers and technology managers for industry and by improving the competitiveness of the participating business organisations.
tgt: Lunegalelo ekusungulweni kwamathuba emisebenzi ngokukhiqiza inqwaba yabacwaningi abanamakhono aphezulu kanye nabaphathi bezobuchwepheshe embonini kanye nokwenza ngcono ubuqhudelwano bezinhlangano zamabhizinisi ezibambe iqhaza.

src: The Programme is a valid, important and efficient element of innovation support that offers considerable value for money both in terms of technology development and developing human resources and industry-related skills.
tgt: Uhlelo luyingxenye esemthethweni, esemqoka futhi egculisayo yokweseka okuqanjwe kabusha okunikezela ngalokho okuyifanele ngempela imali yakho kukhona kokubili ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezindaba zabasebenzi kanye namakhono ahlobene nezezimboni.

src: It also compares favourably to some international programmes.
tgt: Luphinde futhi luqhathaniseke ngokuvumelanayo nezinye izinhlelo zasemazweni aphesheya.

src: Cabinet was briefed on the findings of the Report by the Ministerial Task Team probe into the allegations of the ‘educator posts for sale’ involving individuals, teacher unions and officials of certain Provincial Education Departments.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yoMbiko Wethimba loNgqongqoshe Lokwenziwa Komsebenzi wokuphenya ngezinsolo ‘zokuthengiswa kwezikhala zemisebenzi yothisha’ ezibandakanya abantu abathile, izinyunyana zothisha kanye nezikhulu zeMinyango ethile Yezemfundo Yezifundazwe.

src: Cabinet endorsed recommendations to deal systematically and pointedly with the WEBTOKEN its final Report the Ministerial Task Team provides a critique of the role played by all stakeholders in the process of the selection and recruitment of WEBTOKEN also notes the significant problems in the current system of appointments to posts in the basic education sector and provides recommendations to assist the Department of Basic Education and the basic education sector in general to address the identified challenges.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze izincomo zokubhekana ngendlela enohlelo neqondiswe ngqo emiphumeleni.

src: Cabinet approved submission of the National Forest Amendment Bill to Parliament.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukuhanjiswa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Ezamahlathi Kazwelonke ePhalamende.

src: The Bill amends the National Forests Act, 1998 (Act No.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezamahlathi Kazwelonke, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezichibiyelo kuzokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa kwezamahlathi okuqinile futhi kuphinde kugqugquzele ukubamba iqhaza kwamaqempu abantu abantekenteke, abathembele emahlathini ukuze bakwazi ukuphila, eMkhandlwini Wezokululeka Ngezamahlathi Kazwelonke.

src: Upcoming events.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: President Jacob Zuma will attend the inauguration and swearing-in ceremony of Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni in Kampala on 12 May 2016.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzohambela umcimbi wokugcotshwa kanye nokufungiswa kukaMongameli wase-Uganda u-Yoweri Museveni eKampala ngomhla ziyi-12 Nhlaba 2016.

src: The outgoing visit will further strengthen bilateral relations between South Africa and Uganda.
tgt: Lolu hambo oluphumayo luzophinde luqinise ubudlelwano obumbaxambili phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: President Jacob Zuma will officiate a National Day of Prayer to be held at ABSA Stadium in Durban on 29 April 2016.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma uzokwengamela Usuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ozobanjelwa Ezinkundleni Zemidlalo i-ABSA e-Durban mhla zingama-29 Mbasa 2016.

src: Religious leaders and leaders of civil society formations will join government in praying for the further consolidation of democracy, national unity, social cohesion as well as successful and peaceful 2016 Local Government Elections.
tgt: Abaholi bezenkolo kanye nabaholi bezinhlangano zomphakathi bazohlanganyela nohulumeni ekukhulekeleni okunye ukuqiniswa kombuso wentando yeningi labantu, ubumbano lukazwelonke, ukubumbana komphakathi kanjalo Nokhetho Lohulumeni Bezindawo lowezi-2016 oluyimpumelelo nolunokuthula.

src: Cabinet was briefed on plans by the Department of Arts and Culture to host Africa Month in May 2016 under the theme: “Building a Better Africa and a Better World” as part of the continent’s celebration of the establishment of the Organisation of Africa Unity, now the African Union and the work it has done.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nezinhlelo zoMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko zokusingatha Inyanga ye-Afrika ngoNhlaba 2016 ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika Engcono kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono” njengengxenye yemigubho yezwekazi yokusungulwa kweNhlangano Yobumbano lwase-Afrika (i-OAU), manje esiyaziwa ngokuthi Ubumbano lwaseAfrika (i-African Union) kanye nomsebenzi esiwenzile.

src: President Jacob Zuma will launch Africa Month on the National Day of Prayer on 29 April WEBTOKEN 2016 Africa Month will focus on women and youth development initiatives, while we commemorate the 60th year of the Women’s March and the 40th year of the Youth Uprisings in Soweto.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzokwethula Inyanga yeAfrika ngoSuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ngomhla zingama-29 kuMbasa 2016.Ngowezi-2016 Inyanga ye-Afrika izogxila ezinhlelweni eziqanjwe kabusha zokuthuthukiswa kwabantu besifazane kanye nentsha, ngenkathi sigubha iminyaka engama-60 yeMashi Yabantu Besifazane kanye neminyaka engama-40 Yemibhikiso Yentsha eSoweto.

src: South Africans are urged to participate in the multi-disciplinary programme that involves a wide range of activities including visual arts, theatre, music, lectures and colloquia as well as the 10th anniversary of the African World Heritage Fund.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayanxuswa ukuba babambe iqhaza ohlelweni oluzobe luhlanganise iminxa ehlukahlukene olubandakanya imisebenzi enhlobonhlobo efaka phakathi imisebenzi yobuciko obubukwayo, imidlalo yeshashalazi, umculo, izifundo kanye nezingqungquthela kanjalo nokubungazwa kweminyaka eyi-10 yeSikhwama Samasiko Omhlaba Wase-Afrika.

src: Africa Month serves as a platform to reconnect and recommit ourselves to Pan Africanism and African Renaissance in bringing the people of the continent closer.
tgt: Inyanga yase-Afrika isebenza njengenkundla yokuzixhumana kabusha kanye nokuzibophezela kabusha Obumbanweni lwama-Afrika kanye Nasekuvuselelweni kwe-Afrika ekuhlanganiseni abantu bezwekazi lase-Afrika ndawonye.

src: On 20 May 2016 government will lead the national celebration of the centenary of the University of Fort Hare at the Alice campus in the Eastern Cape.
tgt: Ngomhla zingama-20 Nhlaba 2016 uhulumeni uzohola umgubho kazwelonke weminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare ophikweni oluse-Alice eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: In preparation for the main celebration, President Jacob Zuma has established an Inter-Ministerial Committee (IMC) to plan and coordinate the historic centenary celebration.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umgubho omkhulu, uMongameli u-Jacob Zuma usesungule iKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukahlukene (i-IMC) ukuba lihlele liphinde lididiyele le ngqophamlando yomgubho weminyaka eyikhulu.

src: This historic learning institution served as a beacon during our struggle for freedom and is also known as the “crucible of African leadership” with it being the alma mater of anti-apartheid struggle figures such as the great ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo and Govan Mbeki.
tgt: Lesi sikhungo sokufunda esiyingqophamlando sasebenza njengesikhonkwane ngesikhathi sethu sokuzabalazela inkululeko futhi siphinde saziwe njenge “mbiza yobuholi base-Afrika” ngenxa yokuthi iyona nyuvesi eyafunda izingqalabutho zomzabalazo wokulwisana nobandlululo ezinjengo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo no-Govan Mbeki.

src: It is the only Southern African university to have produced five heads of state: Nelson Mandela of South Africa, Yusuf Lule of Uganda, Robert Mugabe of Zimbabwe, Ntsu Mokhehle of Lesotho and Sir Seretse Khama of WEBTOKEN part of the University of Fort Hare’s centenary celebrations Cabinet calls on the Alumni and members of the public to share their Fort Hare memories for the Tell Your Story campaign using the hashtag #MyFortHare.
tgt: Iyona kuphela inyuvesi eseNingizimu ne-Afrika eyake yakhiqiza izinhloko zombuso ezinhlanu: u-Nelson Mandela waseNingizimu Afrika, u-Yusuf Lule wase-Uganda, u-Robert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho kanye no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: Deputy President Cyril Ramaphosa will lead the South Africa delegation to the 26th World Economic Forum (WEF) Africa in Rwanda between 11 and 13 May 2016.
tgt: Njengengxenye yemigubho yeminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abafundi bangaphambilini bale nyuvesi kanye namalungu omphakathi ukuba abelane ngezinkumbulo anazo nge-Fort Hare emkhankasweni Wokuxoxa Indaba Yakho esebenzisa isibambo esithi #MyFortHare.

src: The forum is hosted under the theme: “Connecting Africa’s Resources through Digital Transformation”.Government through its Nine-Point Plan is advancing the country’s own digital transformation.
tgt: IPhini likaMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uzohola ithimba lezinthunywa zaseNingizimu Afrika eliya Esithangamini Sezomnotho Womhlaba Wonke (i-WEF) sama-26 e-Afrika esizobe sibanjelwe eRwanda phakathi komhla ziyi-11 kanye ne-13 Nhlaba 2016.

src: It is rolling out the first phase of its broadband initiative that will connect more than 5 000 government facilities in eight district municipalities over a three-year period.
tgt: Useqalile ukukhipha isigaba sokuqala sohlelo lwakhe oluqanjwe kabusha lwezinxakanxaka zokuxhumana oluzoxhuma izikhungo zikahulumeni ezingaphezu kwezi-5 000 komasipala bezifunda abayisishiyagalombili esikhathini esiyiminyaka emithathu.

src: Funding to the tune of R740 million has been allocated in support of the rollout.
tgt: Uxhaso lwemali ebalelwa ezigidini ezingama-740 zamarandi selwabiwe ukweseka lokhu kukhishwa kwalesi sigaba.

src: INDABA 2016 at the Inkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre in Durban from 7 to 9 May 2016, is a Pan-African platform that will promote our tourism products to international buyers.
tgt: INDABA 2016 eNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre e-Durban kusukela mhla ziyi-7 kuya mhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016, iyisithangami Sobumbano lwama-Afrika esizokhuthaza imikhiqizo yethu yezokuvakasha kubathengi basemazweni aphesheya.

src: Tourism, as one of the six pillars of economic growth of the National Development Plan, contributed R357 billion to our GDP in 2014 and supported 9 per cent of total employment in South Africa.
tgt: Ezokuvakasha, njengenye yezinsika eziyisithupha zokukhula komnotho woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe, zibe negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-357 zamarandi kwiSamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP) ngowezi-2014 futhi zixhase nge-9% esambeni esiphelele sabantu abaqashiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: The World Travel and Tourism Council estimates that tourism will contribute R560 billion to our GDP by 2025 and will support over two million jobs.
tgt: Umkhandlu Wezokuhamba Nokuvakasha Womhlaba Wonke ulinganisa ngokuthi ezokuvakasha zizoba negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-560 zamarandi kwi-GDP yethu ngowezi-2025 kanti futhi ziyoxhasa ngemisebenzi engaphezu kwezigidi ezimbili.

src: Growing the Tourisms impact in the Oceans Economy is a critical pillar of the Nine-Point Plan, informed by the untapped potential of our oceans, which can contribute to economic growth.
tgt: Ukukhulisa umthelela Wezokuvakasha Emnothweni Wasolwandle kuyinsika esemqoka yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, okususelwe emandleni angakathintwa muntu ezilwandle zethu, angaba negalelo ekukhuleni komnotho.

src: The oceans economy and tourism provide tremendous opportunities for economic growth and job creation.
tgt: Umnotho wasolwandle kanye nezokuvakasha zihlinzeka ngamathuba amangalisayo okukhula komnotho kanye nokusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi.

src: In commemoration of Workers’ Day on 1 May 2016, Cabinet reiterates the country’s commitment to protect worker rights through our progressive labour legislation.
tgt: Ekugujweni koSuku Lwabasebenzi mhla lu-1 Nhlaba 2016, iKhabhinethi igcizelela ukuzibophezela kwezwe ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi ngokusebenzisa imithetho yethu yabasebenzi enenqubekelaphambili.

src: Since 1994 government has through legislation such as the Labour Relations Act, the Basic Conditions of Employment Act, Employment Equity Act and Occupational Health and Safety advanced workers’ rights.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994 uhulumeni esebenzisa imithetho enjengoMthetho Wezobudlelwano Nabasebenzi, uMthetho Wezimo Zokusebenza Eziyisisekelo, uMthetho Wokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana kanye noMthetho Wezempilo Emsebenzini kanye Nokuphepha useqhubezele phambili amalungelo abasebenzi.

src: Cabinet urges Grade 12 learners to start downloading application forms or apply online to institutions of higher learning as part of the Apply Now/ Khetha Career Guidance Campaign.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abafundi beBanga le-12 ukuba baqale ukuthwebula amafomu okufaka izicelo noma bafake izicelo nge-inthanethi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme njengengxenye yoMkhankaso othi Apply Now/Khetha Career Guidance.

src: The Campaign undertaken annually by the Department of Higher Education and Training, will run nationally until September 2016 and assists learners in making informed choices when applying to institutions of higher learning.
tgt: Umkhankaso obanjwa njalo minyaka yonke nguMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, uzobanjwa kuzwelonke kuze kube nguMandulo 2016 futhi uzosiza abafundi ukuba bakhethe ngomqondo ophusile lapho befaka izicelo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.

src: Learners are encouraged to contact the Career Development Services Centre through SMS or a “please call me” on 072 204 5056 or 086 999 0123, email EMAILTOKEN, on Facebook at WEBTOKEN or on Twitter at WEBTOKEN Cabinet’s position on key issues in the environment.
tgt: Abafundi bayagqugquzelwa ukuba baxhumane neSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi ngokuthumela i-SMS noma u-“please call me” ku-072 204 5056 noma ku-086 999 0123, nge-imeyili kuleli kheli: EMAILTOKEN, ku-Facebook kuleli kheli: WEBTOKEN noma ku-Twitter kuleli kheli: WEBTOKEN Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: Cabinet encourages relevant stakeholders to comment on the draft reviewed Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Charter for the South African Mining and Minerals Industry, 2016 which was published in the Government Gazette.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igqugquzela ababambiqhaza abafanelekile ukuba baphawule ohlakeni olubuyekeziwe loMqulu Wokuthuthukiswa Kwabamnyama Kwezomnotho Wezezimboni zaseNingizimu Afrika Zezezimayini kanye Nezimbiwa Phansi, lowezi-2016 olwashicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni.

src: The draft reviewed Mining Charter further integrates government’s transformation policies and legislation to enhance the ease of doing business, create regulatory clarity, predictability and certainty.
tgt: Uhlaka olubuyekeziwe loMqulu Wezezimayini luphinde luhlanganise izinqubomgomo zenguquko zikahulumeni kanye nomthetho wokuthuthukisa ukwenziwa lula kwebhizinisi, ukusungula incanciselo yezokulawula, ukuqagulwa kanye nokuqiniseka.

src: It is also aligned to the provisions of the Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Act, 2003 (Act No.
tgt: Luphinde lwahanjelaniswa nezimiso zoMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwabamanyama Kwezomnotho, wezi-2003 (uMthetho onguNombolo 53 wezi-2003) kanye Namakhodi Enkambiso Enhle (Amakhodi e-DTI).

src: Cabinet notes that approval of the proposed acquisition of SAB Miller by AB InBev is under consideration by the competition authorities.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphelile ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokuthengwa okuhlongozwayo kwe-SAB Miller yi-AB InBev kusengaphansi kokucutshungulwa ngabasebagunyeni ezemiqhudelwano.

src: Cabinet welcomes the agreed approach by the Minister of Economic Development and AB InBev to the competition authorities on a range of public interest issues.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamukela indlela yokusebenza okuvunyelwene ngayo ethathwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho kanye ne-AB InBev kwabasemagunyeni ezemiqhudelwano maqondana nezindaba ezinhlobonhlobo ezithinta umphakathi.

src: The commitment by the company serves as a guide, on public interest issues, to other companies in merger and acquisitions in similar circumstances.
tgt: Ukuzibophezela kwenkampani kusebenza njengomkhombandlela, ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi, kwezinye izinkampani ezihlangene kanye nasekuthengweni okunezimo ezifanayo.

src: This includes an agreed commitment by the company to spend R1 billion over the next five years to promote small-scale farming and local supplier development, new enterprises, energy and water efficiency technologies and youth development.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya isibophezelo okuvunyelwene ngaso yinkampani sokuchitha isigidigidi samarandi eminyakeni eyisihlanu ezayo ukukhuthaza ukufuya nokulima kwabalimi abancane kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabaphakeli bempahla balapha ezweni ngaphakathi, amabhizinisi amasha, ubuchwepheshe bamandla kanye namanzi anele kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwentsha.

src: The commitment on jobs including an undertaking to avoid involuntarily retrenchment of workers as a result of the merger and to maintain employment levels at the company for the next five years, are part of a ground-breaking agreement between the company and government to support industrialisation, small business development and job creation.
tgt: Ukuzibophezela ngemisebenzi kubandakanya nesithembiso sokugwema ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi bengazikhethelanga bona njengomphumela wokuhlangana kwezinkampani kanye nokugcina amazinga okuqashwa enkampanini iminyaka emihlanu ezayo, kuyingxenye yesivumelwano esiyingqophamlando esingakaze sibonakale phakathi kwenkampani nohulumeni ukweseka ezezimboni, ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane kanye nokusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi.

src: In a separate development, Cabinet notes the coming into effect of provisions of the Competition Amendment Act that makes it a criminal offence for directors and management to collude in the fixing of prices, tenders or markets.
tgt: Ngakolunye uhlangothi oluseceleni, iKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezimiso zoMthetho Wokuchibiyela Imincintiswano ezikwenza kube icala lobugebengu ukuthi abaqondisi kanye nabaphathi bavumelane ngasese ekuphekeni kwamanani, amathenda noma izimakethe.

src: These provisions are part of the measures to step up the fight against cartels that damage the economy and impose high prices on consumers.
tgt: Lezi zimiso ziyingxenye yezinyathelo zokukhuphula ukulwisana nombimbi olucekela phansi umnotho futhi lubeke amanani aphezulu kubathengi.

src: We call on businesses in South Africa to compete based on lower prices, more innovation, improved quality of goods offered or superior service to customers rather than on collusion.
tgt: Sinxusa amabhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika ukuba ancintisane ngokugxila emananini aphansi, ukuqamba kabusha okuthe xaxa, ikhwalithi eyenziwe ngcono yezimpahla ezinikezelwayo noma insizakalo ephezulu kubathengi kunokuba kuvunyelwane ngasese.

src: Cabinet noted how highly regulated the banking sector is in South Africa - and globally, and the need for South Africa to comply with international standards like Basel III and Anti-money laundering regulations of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), which have been previously approved by Cabinet, and supported by underlying legislation approved by Government.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphelile indlela ephezulu umkhakha wezokubhanga olawulwa ngayo la eNingizimu Afrika – kanye nasemhlabeni jikelele, kanye nesidingo sokuba iNingizimu Afrika ithobele amazinga omhlaba wonke njenge-Basel III kanye nemithetho ephikisana nokushintshisana ngemali Yombutho Wethimba Lokusebenza Lezezimali (i-FATF), ebivele kakade isigunyaziwe yiKhabhinethi, futhi yasekelwa yimitheshwana engaphansi eyagunyazwa nguHulumeni.

src: The Twin Peaks system will also regulate market conduct in the banking and broader financial sector.".
tgt: Uhlelo lama-Twin Peaks nalo luzolawula ukuziphatha kwezimakethe emkhakheni wezokubhanga kanye nakwezezimali ngobubanzi.".

src: Cabinet welcomes the outcomes from the WEBTOKENternational Monetary Fund and World Bank Groups Spring Meeting which took place under the theme “Global Challenges, Global Solutions”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukele imiphumela evela eMhlanganweni Wasentwasahlobo wezi-2016 Wesikhwama Sezezimali Somhlaba Wonke kanye Namaqembu Ebhange Lomhlaba owabanjwa ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Izinselele Zomhlaba Wonke, Izixazululo Zomhlaba Wonke”.

src: A three-pronged approach to ignite growth at a global level was proposed, encouraging countries to use all policy levers to spur growth, i. e. monetary, fiscal and structural reforms.
tgt: Indlela yokusebenza embaxantathu yokokhwezela ukukhula ezingeni lomhlaba wonke yahlongozwa, egqugquzela amazwe ukuba asebenzise izilinganiso zenqubomgomo ukuqhubezela ukukhula, okuwokuphathelene nezezimali, isikhwama sezimali zikahulumeni kanye nezinguquko zokwakhiwa kwazo.

src: Countries with monetary and fiscal space were encouraged to do more to boost demand however, implementation of structural reforms was critical for all.
tgt: Amazwe anendawo yezezimali kanye nesikhwama sezimali zikahulumeni agqugquzelwa ukuba enze okuthe xaxa ukusimamisa izimfuneko nakuba kunjalo, ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezinguquko zokwakheka kwazo kwakusemqoka kubo bonke.

src: For many this includes investment in infrastructure, innovation and improving the regulatory environment, amongst others.
tgt: Kwabaningi lokhu kubandakanya utshalomali engqalasizindeni, ukuqamba kabusha kanye nokwenza ngcono indawo yokulawula, phakathi kokunye.

src: Cabinet reminds all those eligible voters who have not yet registered and verified their details that they can still do so by visiting their local Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) Office.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza bonke labo abafanelekayo ukuba ngabavoti abangakabhalisi futhi baqinisekise imininingwane yabo ukuthi basangakwenza lokho ngokuhambela iHhovisi labo eliseduze nabo leKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele (i-IEC).

src: This is needed to secure your name on the voters’ roll which will enable eligible voters to exercise their democratic right on 3 August 2016.Cabinet urges eligible voters to ensure that they meet the requirement of providing their address to their local Independent Electoral Commission (IEC) office.
tgt: Lokhu kuyadingeka ukuze uqinisekise igama lakho ohlwini labavoti oluzovumela abavoti abafanelekile ukuba basebenzise ilungelo labo lentandoyeningi mhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016.IKhabhinethi inxusa abavoti abafanelekileyo ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi bayahlangabezana nesidingo sokuhlinzeka ngekheli ehhovisi eliseduzane nabo leKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele.

src: Election queries can be directed to the IEC contact centre on 0800 11 8000, which is open Monday to Friday, from 7am to 9pm.
tgt: Imibuzo mayelana nokhetho ingaqondiswa esikhungweni sezokuxhumana se-IEC ku-0800 11 8000, esivulwa kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, kusukela ngehora lesi-7 ekuseni kuya ehoreni lesi-9 kusihlwa.

src: Cabinet congratulates Transnet, National Prosecuting Authority, SABC and the Departments of Higher Education and Training, International Relations and Cooperation, and Justice and Constitutional Development for being ranked “Most Attractive Employers” in South Africa by employer branding company, UNIVERSUCabinet commends Minister of Science and Technology, Naledi Pandor, who received an Order of Merit from the Federal Republic of Germany for her contribution to the development of science globally.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uTransnet, Uphiko Lwezokushushisa Lukazwelonke, Inhlangano Yezokusakaza yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) kanye neMinyango Yezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, Wezobudlelwano Namazwe Omhlaba kanye Nokubambisana kanye Nowezokuthuthukiswa Kwezomthethosisekelo ngokukleliswa njengaba “Qashi Abahehayo Kakhulu” eNingizimu Afrika yinkampani eqopha abaqashi, i-UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi income uNgqongqoshe Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, uNaledi Pandor, othole Umklomelo Wokusebenza Ngobungqaphambili ovela kwi-Federal Republic of Germany ngegalelo lakhe ekuthuthukisweni kwesayensi emhlabeni wonke jikelele.

src: The merit has been awarded to people from around the world for their achievements in political, social or intellectual spheres.
tgt: Umklomelo wokutuswa usunikezwe abantu emhlabeni wonke jikelele ngezimpumelelo zabo kwezepolitiki, kwezenhlalo noma ezigabeni zobuhlakani babo.

src: Cabinet congratulates the Environmental Affairs Director-General Nosipho Ngcaba for receiving the 2015/16 Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic Award from environment publication, The Enviropaedia.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMqondisi-Jikelele Wezemvelo uNosipho Ngcaba ngokuthola Indodo Yokuhlonishwa Impilo Yakhe Yonke yowezi-2015/16 Yokunakekela Ezemvelo eyinikwa yimagazini yezemvelo, i-The Enviropaedia.

src: Cabinet applauds artist Kemang Wa Lehulere for becoming "Artist of the Year" for 2017 which is supported by Deutsche Bank.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ishayele ihlombe iciko uKemang Wa Lehulere ngokuba "Iciko Lonyaka" lowezi-2017 elixhaswe yi-Deutsche Bank.

src: Wa Lehulere, who explores the relevance of the artistic gesture in post-Apartheid South Africa, will present his first institutional solo exhibition in Germany at the Deutsche Bank KunstHalle in Berlin next year.
tgt: UWa Lehulere, ohlola ukufaneleka kwesimo sobuciko eNingizimu Afrika yangemuva kobandlululo, uzokwethula umbukiso wakhe ehamba yedwa e-Germany e-Deutsche Bank Kunst Halle e-Berlin ngonyaka ozayo.

src: Cabinet congratulates the Department of Tourism for winning the Best Public Policy/Support prize in the 2016 African Responsible Tourism Awards.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMnyango Wezokuvakasha ngokuwina umklomelo weNqubomgomo Engungqaphambili Yomphakathi/Yokweseka emncintiswaneni Wezindondo wezi-2016 Wezokuvakasha Ezinobuhlakani wase-Afrika.

src: This accolade is awarded to a public sector department, authority or entity that has made a clear commitment and contribution to advancing responsible tourism.
tgt: Le ndondo inikezelwa emnyangweni womkhakha kahulumeni, isiphathimandla noma isikhungo esenze isibophezelo esicacile kanye negalelo ekuthuthukiseni ezokuvakasha ezinobuhlakani.

src: Cabinet congratulates golfer Branden Grace for winning his first PGA Tour at the RBC Heritage in Hilton Head, UCabinet is saddened by the death of Bertie Lubner who made significant contributions to the development of South Africa as a business leader, philanthropist and honorary life chairman of the SA Jewish Board of Deputies.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele umdlali wegalofu u-Branden Grace ngokuwina umqudelwano wakhe wokuqala we-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage eHilton Head, eMelika.

src: Cabinet extends its deepest condolences to the friends and families of the ten victims (Tiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle and Simphiwe Nhlapo) of a tragic bus crash while they were returning from the ANC Manifesto Rally in Port Elizabeth.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphatheke kabi ngokudlula emhlabeni kuka-Bertie Lubner owaba namagalelo amangalisayo ekuthuthukisweni kweNingizimu Afrika njengomholi wezamabhizinisi, umuntu ophanayo kanye nosihlalo kanomphela wokuhlonishwa weNhlangano yamaJuda aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Cabinet conveyed its condolences to the family and friends of Dr Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, South Africa’s first black fertility specialist.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu kubangani kanye nemindeni yezisulu eziyishumi (uTiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle noSimphiwe Nhlapo) zengozi ebuhlungu yebhasi eyehla ngenkathi bebuya eMbuthanweni Wokuthwelwa Komqulu Wezethembiso Zokhetho we-ANC eBhayi.

src: As a founder of the fertility clinic in the Park Lane Hospital in Johannesburg, Netshidzivhani helped many South Africans start their own families.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kanye nakubangani bakaDkt Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, ungoti wokuqala wenzalo omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Cabinet conveyed condolences to the family and friends of Dene Smuts, former Democratic Alliance Member of Parliament.
tgt: Njengomsunguli womtholampilo wezenzalo eSibhedlela i-Park Lane eGoli, uNetshidzivhani wasiza abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bakwazi ukuqala imindeni yabo.

src: Cabinet salutes her sterling contribution to the development of our constitutional democracy.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kanye nakubangani baka-Dene Smuts, iLungu Laphambilini le-Democratic Alliance ePhalamende.

src: Cabinet joins President Jacob Zuma in wishing Mama Winnie Madikizela-Mandela a speedy recovery and urges that the privacy of the family be respected during this time.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imthulele isigqoko ngegalelo lakhe elihle kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwentando yeningi labantu yethu esekelwe ngumthethosisekelo.

src: Winnie Mandela is widely respected for her role in our struggle for freedom which contributed to ending oppressive policies and bringing democracy to South Africa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye noMongameli u-Jacob Zuma ekufiseleni uMama u-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ukululama okusheshayo futhi iyacela ukuba kuhlonishwe umndeni nempilo yawo yangasese ngalesi sikhathi.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and the relevant clearance.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Paul Steenkamp to the National Advisory Council on Innovation.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kuka-Paul Steenkamp eMkhandlwini Wezokweluleka Kazwelonke maqondana Nokuqamba Kabusha.

src: Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson as the Chief Financial Officer of SENTECLumko Caesario Mtimde as the Chief Executive Officer of the Universal Services and Access Agency of South Africa.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kuka-Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson njengeSikhulu Esiphezulu Sezezimali se-SENTECUkuqashwa kukaLumko Caesario Mtimde njengoMphathi Omkhulu weSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zomhlaba Wonke kanye Nokufinyeleleka saseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Re-appointment of Adv.
tgt: Ukuqokwa kabusha kuka-Adv Rory Wayne Voller njengePhini likaKhomishana weKhomishana Wezinkampani Nemisebenzi Yobuciko.

src: Rory Wayne Voller as the Deputy Commissioner of the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission.
tgt: Ukunwetshwa kwenkontileka kaLungisa Fuzile njengoMqondisi Jikelele kuMnyango Wezezimali Kuzwelonke.

src: Implementation of Key Government Programmes.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: Cabinet took note of the report-back by the Minister of Finance to the President, on the progress of Government’s consultations with the private sector and labour on the economy.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuqaphelile umbiko wokubuyisa impendulo owenziwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali kuMongameli, maqondana nenqubekelaphambili yezingxoxo zikaHulumeni nabomkhakha ozimele kanye nabasebenzi kwezomnotho.

src: The President mandated the Minister to lead engagements with these social partners to map out a strategy and come up with measures for growing the economy and preserving the country’s credit rating.
tgt: UMongameli ugunyaze uNgqongqoshe ukuba ahole izingxoxo nalaba balingani bezokuhlalisana ukuze kuhlahlwe iqhinga futhi kuqhanyukwe nezinyathelo zokukhulisa umnotho kanye nokulondoloza ukukleliswa kwezwe kwezezikweletu.

src: Cabinet is pleased that this work has culminated in concrete initiatives that will improve the country’s economic prospects.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijabulile ukuthi lo msebenzi uphethwe ngokutholakala kwezinhlelo eziqanjwe kabusha ezibambekayo ezizokwenza ngcono amathuba ezwe ezomnotho.

src: The President announced several priority initiatives on Monday, which include: (1) a joint private and public sector fund for Small Business Support, (2) addressing constraints to increasing investment in order to accelerate inclusive growth, (3) government and private sector co-investment in infrastructure drawing on experience of the successful Independent Power Producer Programme and (4) strengthening State Owned Enterprises to ensure their financial sustainability and reinforcing their role in driving development.
tgt: UMongameli umemezele izinhlelo eziqanjwe kabusha ezimbalwa eziseqhulwini ngoMsombuluko, ezibandakanya: (1) isikhwama esihlanganyelwe somkhakha ozimele kanye nokahulumeni Sokuxhasa Amabhizinisi Amancane, (2) ukubhekana nemigoqo evimbela ukukhushulwa kotshalomali ukuze kusheshiswe ngesivinini ukukhula okufaka konke okuphelele, (3) ukutshala izimali ngokuhlanganyela kukahulumeni nomkhakha ozimele engqalasizindeni ngokubukela kwisibonelo sempumelelo yoHlelo Labakhiqizi Abazimele Bakages kanye (4) nokuqinisa Amabhizinisi Kahulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuqina nokuzinza kwezezimali zawo kanye nokuqinisa indima yawo ekugqugquzeleni intuthuko.

src: These announcements are testament to what this country can achieve when all social partners come together to work towards the same goal.
tgt: Lezi zimemezelo ziwubufakazi balokho leli lizwe elingakwazi ukukuzuza uma bonke abalingani bezokuhlalisana behlangana ndawonye ukuze basebenzele injongo efanayo.2 IKhabhinethi isalokhu inethemba lokuthi ukuhlanganiswa okunesankahlu kwezimali zezwe nguhulumeni, ingqophamlando yokuqoqwa kwemali eyitriliyoni yamarandi yiSikhungo Sokuqoqwa Kwezimali saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS) kanye nemingenelelo yesikhathi esifushane eyisihlanu esanda kumenyezelwa, konke kugcwalisa Uhlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuguquka kwezinto engcebweni yethu yezomnotho.

src: Cabinet remains confident that government’s aggressive fiscal consolidation, the historic R1 trillion collection by the South African Revenue Service and the recently announced five short-term interventions, all complement the Nine Point plan so as to ensure a turn-around in our economic fortunes.
tgt: Ukuqoqwa kwezimali okukhuphukile ngu-SARS kuzophinda kwenze uHulumeni akwazi ukuhambisa izinsizakalo ezizokwenza ngcono izinga lezimpilo zazo zonke izakhamuzi zakhe.3 IKhabhinethi iyasamukela isimemezelo sesikhungo sezokuklelisa, esibizwa ngokuthi yi-Moody’s Investor Services, esiqinisekise kabusha esontweni eledlule ukukleliswa kwezwe kwezezikweletu ngamaphuzu amabili ngaphezu kwezinga lotshalomali olungaphansi.

src: The increased revenue collection by SARS will further enable Government to deliver services that will improve the quality of lives of all its citizens.
tgt: Ngokuqinisekisa lokhu kukleliswa, i-Moody’s ikuqaphelile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isifinyelela ekuguquleni izinto emva kweminyaka eminingi yokukhula okuntekenteke kwezomnotho kanti-ke nezinyathelo zokuhlanganiswa ezinesankahlu kwisabelomali sowezi-2016 zizozinzisa isikweletu sikahulumeni Kwisamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP) onyakeni esikuwona.

src: All parties are agreed that collaborative efforts need to be strengthened to give impetus to the economic recovery.
tgt: Zonke izinhlangothi ziyavumelana ukuthi imizamo ehlanganyelwe kudingeka iqiniswe ukufaka ugqozi ekusimameni komnotho.

src: We also note that the Minister of Finance’ work with social partners includes a credit ratings workstream that will identify potential reforms and interventions to preserve South Africa’s strong capital markets and investment grade credit rating.4 The President appreciates the Budget Votes by respective Ministers which address the needs of all South Africans.
tgt: Siyaqaphela futhi ukuthi umsebenzi kaNgqongqoshe Wezezimali kanye nabalingani bezokuhlalisana ubandakanya ithimba labasebenzi bezokukleliswa kwezezikweletu elizohlonza izinguquko ezinokwenzeka kanye nezinyathelo zokugenelela ukuze kulondolozwe izimakethe zezimali eziqinile kanye nokukleliswa kwezezikweletu kwezinga lotshalomali.4 UMongameli uyazincoma Izinkulumo Zevoti Zezabiwomali ezenziwe ngoNgqongqoshe abahlukene ezibhekana nezidingo zabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: The progress reports and plans emanating from the Departmental Budget Votes demonstrates that South Africa is a nation at work, with government leading the way, in building a better life for all.
tgt: Imibiko yenqubekelaphambili kanye nezinhlelo ezisuselwa Ezinkulumweni Zevoti Zezabiwomali Zeminyango kubonisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyisizwe esiphezu komsebenzi, nalapho uhulumeni ezihola phambili, ekwakheni impilo engcono yawo wonke umuntu.

src: Concrete measures have been put in place to reduce the negative impact of the global economic downturn on our economy, and to prepare for robust growth when the economic cycle turns positive.
tgt: Izinyathelo ezibambekayo sezenziwe ukunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle wokuwohloka kwamandla emali emhlabeni wonke kwezomnotho wethu, kanye nokulungiselela ukukhula ngomfutho lapho umjikelezo wezomnotho usushintsha uba muhle.

src: We are also working hard to remove domestic impediments to growth.
tgt: Sisebenza kanzima futhi ukususa izithiyo zokukhula ezikhona lapha ngaphakathi ezweni.

src: The budget votes also demonstrate that government, labour and business are working together, more than any other time, to find ways of re-igniting growth and building a better life for all.
tgt: Izinkulumo zevoti zezabiwomali ziphinde zibonise ukuthi uhulumeni, abasebenzi kanye nabamabhizinisi basebenza ndawonye, ukudlula zonke ezinye izikhathi, ukuthola izindlela zokuphemba kabusha ukukhula kanye nokwakha impilo engcono yawo wonke umuntu.

src: This includes vigorous implementation of the Nine Point Plan, announced by President Jacob Zuma in his 2015 State of the Nation Address as well as Operation Phakisa, designed to fast track implementation of solutions to critical development areas.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqaliswa ukusebenza okunomdlandla koHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, olwamenyezelwa nguMongameli u-Jacob Zuma Enkulumweni Echaza Isimo Sezwe yowezi-2015 kanjalo ne-Operation Phakisa, eyasungulelwa ukusheshisa ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezisombululo ezindaweni ezibucayi zentuthuko.

src: These programmes address critical issues from the National Development Plan, such as reducing poverty and unemployment.
tgt: Lezi zinhlelo zibhekana nezinkinga ezibucayi ezivela oHlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP), ezinjengokunciphisa ubuphofu kanye nokusweleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.5 IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi isimo sezwe sokusweleka kwamathuba emisebenzi kuyabhekanwa naso ngokuqaliswa ukusebenza kwe-NDP ngokusebenzisa ukungenelela kwezomnotho koHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye okufuna ukuphemba kabusha ukukhula kanye nokuthuthukisa imisebenzi emikhakheni esemqoka yezomnotho wethu.

src: The collaboration of the private sector is pivotal for a successful outcome.
tgt: Ukusebenzisana komkhakha ozimele kusemqoka ukuze kutholakale umphumela onempumelelo.

src: Government is using all available initiatives including its Industrial Policy Action Plan (IPAP) to create more labour absorbing production and services sectors to address unemployment which has been further impacted by the difficult global and local economic conditions.
tgt: Uhulumeni usebenzisa zonke izinhlelo eziqanjwe kabusha ezikhona kubandakanya noHlelo lwakhe Lokusebenzisa Inqubomgomo Yezezimboni (i-IPAP) ukusungula imikhiqizo eminingi eqasha abasebenzi ngokugcwele futhi esebenzela imikhakha ukuze ibhekane nokusweleka kwamathuba emisebenzi okubuye kwathelelwa kabi izimo ezinzima zezomnotho zalapha ekhaya nezomhlaba wonke.

src: Minister of Trade and Industry, Rob Davies launched the eighth annual iteration of the IPAP 2016/17 to 2018-19 on 9 May 2016 at a 100% black-owned casting and machining foundry in Gauteng.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezezimboni, u-Rob Davies wethule isibuyekezo sesishiyagalombili sonyaka se-IPAP yowezi-2016/17 kuya kowezi-2018-19 ngomhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016 ngo-100% wemikhiqizo ephethwe ngabantu abamnyama kanye nendawo yokubunjwa kwensimbi eGauteng.

src: Government emphasizes the importance of developing close cooperation with cutting-edge local industrial companies involved not just in infrastructure development, transport and logistics, but across a wide range of technologically sophisticated, export ready and labour intensive sectors of the South African economy as a totality.
tgt: Uhulumeni ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokusungula ukusebenzisana ndawonye kanye nezinkampani zezezimboni zangaphakathi ezweni ezinobuchule ezingabandakanyiwe kuphela nje ekuthuthukisweni kwengqalasizinda, kwezokuthutha kanye nokuhanjiswa kwezimpahla, kodwa ezibandakanywe emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo yezobuchwepheshe obuphucukile, yezimpahla ezilungele ukuthengiswa emazweni angaphandle kanye negxile kubasebenzi yezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngobubanzi.

src: While the Quarterly Labour Force Survey for the first quarter of 2016 recorded an increase in unemployment to per cent on a quarter on quarter basis, 2016 employment levels are higher by 204 000 employed people when compared with the first quarter of 2015.
tgt: Nakuba Ucwaningo Lwekota Lezabasebenzi lwekota yokuqala yowezi-2016 luqophe ukukhuphuka emathubeni omsebenzi kuya kuma.7% ekota ngekota, amazinga amathuba emisebenzi ezi-2016 aphezulu ngezi-204 000 zabantu abaqashiwe uma eqhathaniswa nekota yokuqala yowezi-20.6 IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukunikezelwa Kwesilulu Sentsha sase-Beaufort West, eNtshonalanga Kapa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma, esihlinzeka ngesikhungo entsheni, lapho ingakwazi khona ukuzisimamisa.

src: The Hub has a mix of facilities that provide for holistic development of young people and for the community at large.
tgt: Isilulu sinengxube yezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngokuthuthukiswa okuphelele kwabantu abasha kanye nomphakathi ngobubanzi.

src: The facilities available in this youth hub will provide young people from poor communities with opportunities to better participate and contribute positively to their communities and to the country.
tgt: Izikhungo ezitholakalayo kulesi silulu sentsha zizohlinzeka abantu abasha abavela emiphakathini ehluphekayo ngamathuba okuthi babambe iqhaza kangcono futhi babe negalelo elihle emiphakathini yabo kanye nasezweni.

src: The fully equipped Skills Centre that is being operated by South Cape College will provide training in business administration, end user computing and early childhood development to 200 National Rural Youth Service Corps (NARYSEC) participants per year.
tgt: Isikhungo Samakhono esinazo zonke izinsiza esisetshenziswa yi-South Cape College sizohlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa ekuphathweni kwamabhizinisi, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabantwana kusenesikhathi kubabambiqhaza abangama-200 boMbutho Kazwelonke Wemisebenzi Yentsha Yasemakhaya (i-NARYSEC) ngonyaka ngamunye.

src: NARYSEC is a long-term programme where only rural youth are targeted, recruited and contracted for a period of two years.
tgt: I-NARYSEC iwuhlelo lwesikhathi eside lapho kuhloswe khona intsha yasemakhaya kuphela, iqashwa khona bese inikwa inkontileka yeminyaka emibili.

src: Youth between the ages of 18 and 25 years old are recruited and then enrolled for training in various skills that will equip them, both with theoretical and practical knowledge, to create employment for themselves and other people in their communities.
tgt: Intsha eneminyaka yobudala ephakathi kweyi-18 nama-25 iyaqokwa bese ibhaliselwa ukuqeqeshelwa amakhono anhlobonhlobo azoyihlomisa, ngolwazi olucatshangwayo kanye noluphathekayo, ukuze izisungulele yona amathuba emisebenzi kanye nabanye abantu emiphakathini yabo.

src: Cabinet welcomes the recently held 2016 Open Government Partnership (OGP) Africa Regional Meeting which was hosted by South Africa under the theme "Open Government for Sustainable Development in Africa" from 5 to 6 May 2016.This gathering comes seven months after South Africa became the Lead Chairperson of the Open Government Partnership.
tgt: Lesi Silulu Sentsha siwumklamo Wokuzwa Amanzi Ngobhoko futhi ongowokuqala walolu hlobo, futhi uzosatshalaliswa kwezinye izifundazwe.7 IKhabhinethi iyawamukela Umhlangano Wesifunda sase-Afrika Wokubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile (i-OGP) wezi-2016 owawusingethwe yiNingizimu Afrika kusukela mhla ziyi-5 kuya ziyi-6 Nhlaba 2016 ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi "Uhulumeni Ovulekile Wentuthuko Eqinile Neqhubekayo e-Afrika".Lo mbuthano uza emva kwezinyanga eziyisikhombisa emva kokuba iNingizimu Afrika yaba nguSihlalo Oholayo Wokubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile.

src: Open government principles are crucial for achieving a much broader range of sustainable development goals, linking openness to governance for the improvement of the vulnerable and poor around the world.
tgt: Imigomo kahulumeni ovulekile isemqoka ekufezekiseni izinjongo zentuthuko eqinile ezibanzi nezihlukehlukene, nezixhumanisa ukuvuleleka ekubuseni ukuze kwenziwe ngcono labo abantekenteke nabahlwempu emhlabeni wonke.

src: The Open Government Partnership and Open Government is also a key enabler that will assist the global community to achieve the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.
tgt: Ukubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile kanye Nohulumeni Ovulekile kuphinde kube isivumeli esisemqoka esizosiza umphakathi wasemhlabeni jikelele ukuba ufezekise i-Ajenda yowezi-2030 Yentuthuko Eqinile Neqhubekayo.

src: This Regional Summit was the biggest Open Government Partnership (OGP) Regional summit ever organised by the OGP with very substantive outcomes coming out of each session throughout the WEBTOKEN keeping with governments commitment to partnership and good governance, this summit attracted participants from various Civil Society Organisations (CSO) from around the world that are rooted in communities across different sectors outside the traditional CSO’s that have always been part of the partnership.8 Cabinet notes the approval of the merger of three bottling plants to form the continent's largest bottling plant, Coca-Cola Beverages Africa.
tgt: Lo Mhlangano Wezifunda ube ngumhlangano Wezifunda omkhulu kunayo yonke Wokubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile (i-OGP) owake wahlelwa yi-OGP obe nemiphumela ebambekayo ebivela kwisiqubu ngasinye somhlangano kwaze kwaba inkomfa iyophela.

src: Cabinet welcomes the agreement on public interest conditions for the merger between government and the Coca-Cola Beverages Africa merger parties that can support our efforts for greater industrialisation in the South African economy.
tgt: Ngokuhambisana nesibophezelo sohulumeni sokubambisana kanye nokuphatha okuhle, lo mhlangano uhehe ababambiqhaza abavela Ezinhlanganweni Zemiphakathi (ama-CSO) ezihlukahlukene emhlabeni wonke ezigxile nezizinze emiphakathini kuyo yonke imikhakha enhlobonhlobo engaphandle kwama-CSO ajwayelekile abehlala njalo eyingxenye yokubambisana.8 IKhabhinethi iyakuqaphela ukugunyazwa kokuhlangana kwezinkampani ezintathu zeziphuzo ezisemabhodleleni ukwakha inkampani yeziphuzo zamabhodlela enkulukazi ezwenikazi, i-Coca-Cola Beverages Africa.

src: The agreement safeguards aggregate employment levels in the company for a period of three years, protects workers in the bargaining unit from merger-related retrenchments, supports localisation of the supply chain and commits to develop historically disadvantaged farmers and suppliers to the company.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamukela isivumelwano maqondana nezimo zezimfuno zomphakathi mayelana nokuhlangana phakathi kukahulumeni kanye ne-Coca-Cola Beverages Afrika okuwuhlangana kwezinhlangothi ezinkulu okungeseka imizamo yethu yokuba nezimboni ezinkulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Furthermore, R400 million has been committed to fund enterprise development in the agricultural value chain and another R400 million incremental investment to develop downstream distribution and retail capabilities with associated skills development and training.
tgt: Isivumelwano sivikela amazinga okuqashwa ngokugcwele enkampanini isikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu, sivikela abasebenzi abasophikweni lwezingxoxo zamaholo ekudilizweni emsebenzini ngezizathu ezihlobene nokuhlangana kwezinkampani, siseka uchungechunge lokuphakelwa kwempahla lwalapha ngaphakathi ezweni futhi siyazibophezela ukuthuthukisa abalimi ababekhishwe inyumbazane ngaphambilini kanye nabaphakeli bempahla enkampanini.

src: The agreement opens fridge space in coolers owned or supplied by Coca-Cola to smaller retailers: ten percent of fridge space will be available to rival products from smaller producers in retail establishments where only Coca-Cola supplied coolers are available.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, izigidi ezingama-400 zamarandi seziboshezelwe ukuxhasa ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi asochungechungeni lokuphakelwa kwempahla yezolimo kanti ezinye izigidi ezingama-400 zamarandi zikhuphule utshalomali ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusatshalaliswa kwempahla iya emazingeni aphansi kanye namandla amabhizinisi ahlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nokuqeqesha.

src: This opens the market to new entrants and small bottlers, helping to avoid restrictive business practices that keep small and medium-sized businesses out of WEBTOKEN addition, the company's long term investment in the country's economic and socialdevelopment will be enhanced through the establishment of the merged entity's headquarters in South Africa.
tgt: Isivumelwano sivulela isikhala sokufaka efrijini eziqandisini eziphethwe noma eziphakelwe ngu-Coca-Cola emabhizinisini amancane: i-10% yesikhala sokufaka efrijini sizotholakala ukufaka imikhiqizo eyizimbangi evela kubakhiqizi abancane ezitolo ezinkulu lapho kuneziqandisi eziphakelwe ngu-Coca-Cola kuphela ezitholakalayo.

src: The agreement follows a recent similar agreement entered into with Annhauser Beush InBev relating to the purchase of SAB Miller.
tgt: Lokhu kuvulela imakethe kubhizinisi amasha kanye nabakhiqizi abancane beziphuzo ezisemabhodleleni, okusiza ukugwema imisebenzi yebhizinisi enemikhawulo egcina amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi nendawo evaleleke ngaphandle kwemakethe.

src: In particular, in their emphasis on employment, localisation and small business development, these agreements point to the importance of balancing corporate mergers with public interest issues and set a standard for companies contemplating similar mergers or acquisitions.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, utshalomali lwesikhathi eside lwenkampani ekuthuthukisweni kwezomnotho kanye nenhlalakahle yezwe luzothuthukiswa ngokusungulwa kwamahhovisi akomkhulu enkampani ehlanganisiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Cabinet noted the launch of the Mpact Polymers R350 million bottle-to-bottle plant in partnership with Coca-Cola.
tgt: Isivumelwano silandela esinye isivumelwano sakamuva esifana naso okungenwe kuso kanye ne-Annhauser Beush InBev esihlobene nokuthengwa kwe-SAB Miller.

src: This initiative is in response to the Government's legal framework working through the Environmental Affairs' National Waste Management Strategy goal to promote recycling enterprises.
tgt: Ngokukhethekile, ekugcizeleleni kwabo maqondana namathuba omsebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi alapha ngaphakathi ezweni kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane, lezi zivumelwano zikhomba ukubaluleka kokubhalansisa ukuhlangana kwamabhizinisi kanye nezinkinga zezimfuno zomphakathi bese zibeka izinga okumele ligcinwe yizinkampani ezicabanga ukwenza ukuhlangana okufanayo noma ukuthenga ezinye izinkampani.9 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphelile ukwethulwa kwenkampani yamabhodlela ebiza izigidi ezingama-350 zamarandi yi-Mpact Polymers ngokubambisana no-Coca-Cola.

src: The plant is a first of its kind on the African continent diverting 29 000 tonnes (polyethylene terephthalate) PET waste bottles with an estimated saving of 186 000 cubic metres of landfill space and will contribute to reduction of Carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions of approximately 53 000 tonnes per annum.
tgt: Le nkampani ingeyokuqala ngqa yalolu hlobo ezwenikazi lase-Afrika eguqula amathani ayizi-29 000 (e-polyethylene terephthalate) amabhodlela asesetshenzisiwe e-PET okunesilinganiso esiqaguliwe sokonga amamitha aphindwe kathathu ayizi-186 000 endawo yokulahla udoti futhi kuzoba negalelo ekuncishisweni kwezintuthu zomoya ongcolile (i-CO2) ngamathani abalelwa ezi-53 000 ngonyaka ngamunye.

src: The Industrial Development Corporation (IDC) provided a R210 million loan facility as well as R30m for its 21% equity stake and the Department of Trade and Industry granted a section 12(I) tax incentive.
tgt: Inhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni (i-IDC) ihlinzeke ngemalimboleko yezigidi ezingama-210 zamarandi kanjalo nezigidi ezingama-30 zamarandi ngo-21% wayo wezokulingana kanti futhi noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni unikezele ngesigaba 12(I) somthobanhliziyo wentela.

src: The recycling plant provides jobs to 80 employees and 1 000 jobs to waste collectors.
tgt: Inkampani esebenzisa kabusha osekulahliwe ihlinzeka ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi abangama-80 kanye nemisebenzi eyi-1 000 kubantu abaqoqa imfucuza.

src: Partnerships like this are an important engine for economic growth, creating thousands of jobs in the recycling economy that is worth about R50 billion.
tgt: Ukubambisana okufana nalokhu kuyinjini esemqoka yokukhula komnotho, kusungula izinkulungwane zemisebenzi emnothweni wokusebenzisa kabusha osekulahliwe onengcebo ebalelwa ezigidigidini ezingama-50 zamarandi.

src: Currently, plastic recycling alone provides income opportunities for more than 60 000 waste pickers.
tgt: Njengamanje, ukusetshenziswa kabusha koplastiki asebelahliwe kukodwa nje kuhlinzeka ngamathuba emali engenayo kubantu ababutha imfucuza abangaphezu kwama-60 000.

src: Mpact Polymers, state of the art recycling plant complies with EU food safety specifications and is the first such factory in Africa which also meets Coca-Cola’s full certification protocol for PET bottles.10 Cabinet welcomes the report-back on the Integrated Strategic Management of Rhinoceros which has shown that South Africa has turned the tide on rhino poaching.
tgt: I-Mpact Polymers, inkampani esebenzisa kabusha osekulahliwe esezingeni lomhlaba iyahambelana nemibandela yezokuphepha kokudla ye-EU njengoba iyifektri yokuqala yalolu hlobo e-Afrika futhi iphinde ihlangabezane nomgomo wokugunyazwa ngokugcwele we-Coca-Cola wamabhodlela e-PET.10 IKhabhinethi iyawamukela umbiko wokuphendula maqondana Nokuphathwa Ngobuqhinga Obudidiyelwe Kobhejane osekukhombisile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isinqobile ekugcineni maqondana nokuzingelwa kobhejane ngokungemthetho.

src: Since the beginning of this year alone 206 alleged poachers have been arrested.
tgt: Kusukela kuqale lo nyaka nje kuphela abantu abazingela obhejane ngokungemthetho abangama-206 sebeboshiwe.

src: The Integrated Strategic Management Approach was adopted by Cabinet in August 2014 which saw the Security Cluster implementing a multi-disciplinary, multi-sectoral intervention to protect rhino in South Africa.11 Cabinet congratulates the country for hosting a successful 2016 Tourism Indaba in Durban Kwazulu-Natal, which concluded on Monday, 9 May 2016 with numerous successful interactions between 1 047 exhibitors from 18 African countries and 1 856 buyers from across the globe.
tgt: Indlela Yokusebenza Yokuphathwa Ngobuqhinga Obudidiyelwe yamukelwa yiKhabhinethi ngoNcwaba wezi-2014 neyabonisa Umkhakha Wezokuvikela uqalisa ukusebenza ukungenelela okumfundiso-ningi nokumkhakha-ningi ukuvikela obhejane eNingizimu Afrika.11 IKhabhinethi ihalalisele izwe ngokusingatha ngempumelelo i-Tourism Indaba yowezi-2016 e-Durban KwaZulu-Natali, ephethwe ngoMsombuluko, mhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016 ebe nezingxoxo ezimbalwa eziyimpumelelo phakathi kwababukisi abayi-1 047 abavela emazweni ase-Afrika ayi-18 kanye nabathengi abayi-1 856 abavela emhlabeni wonke.

src: This year, INDABA hosted 3000 more meetings than last year.
tgt: Kulo nyaka, INDABA isingathe imihlangano eyizi-3 000 ngaphezu konyaka odlule.

src: In total 14 000 business meetings took place over the three days of INDABA, presenting a significant economic benefit potential.
tgt: Sekukonke imihlangano yamabhizinisi eyizi-14 000 ebanjiwe ezinsukwini ezintathu ze-INDABA, eveze ithuba eliyingqayizivele lomhlomulo wezomnotho.

src: The event was also attended by 575 national and international journalists.
tgt: Lo mcimbi ubuhanjelwe yizintatheli ezingama-575 zalapha ekhaya kanye nezangaphandle.

src: The INDABA focussed on the industry's small, medium and micro enterprises (SMMEs) showcasing products and services from promising small travel businesses.
tgt: INDABA ibigxile ekutheni osomabhizinisi bemboni abancane, abaphakathi nendawo nabakhulu (ama-SMME) babukise ngemikhiqizo yabo kanye nezinsizakalo kosomabhizinisi abancane bezokuvakasha abathembisayo.

src: 70 enterprises gave workshops on how to access the market - and grow.
tgt: Amabhizinisi angama-70 ahlomulile emihlanganweni yokucobelelana ngolwazi maqondana nokuthi ungayifinyelela kanjani imakethe – bese uyakhula.

src: SMMES have the potential to become big business.
tgt: Ama-SMME anamathuba okuba ngamabhizinisi amakhulu.

src: The INDABA has bolstered the role SMMEs play in the economic development of both developed and developing countries, in growing the tourism sector.
tgt: INDABA iqinise indima ama-SMME ayidlalayo ekuthuthukisweni komnotho wamazwe asethuthukile kanye nasathuthuka, ekukhuliseni umkhakha wezokuvakasha.

src: Unlocking the potential of SMMEs is one of the critical job drivers in the Nine-Point Plan that will grow and transform the economy and create jobs.
tgt: Ukuthukulula amathuba ama-SMME kungomunye wemibhidlango esemqoka yemisebenzi oHlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye oluzokhulisa futhi luguqule umnotho bese lusungula amathuba emisebenzi.

src: Key Cabinet decisions.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: Cabinet discussed the implementation on the Truth and Reconciliation Commission’s (TRC) recommendations and proposed options for the implementation of the Community Rehabilitation Projects.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idingide ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezincomo zeKhomishana Yamaqiniso Nokubuyisana (i-TRC) futhi yahlongoza nezindlela zokuqaliswa ukusebenza Kwemiklamo Yokuhlunyeleliswa Komphakathi.

src: Realisation of Community Rehabilitation Projects redress the injustices of the past through the rehabilitation of 128 communities that were subjected to acts of violence and destruction during the conflict period (1 March 1960-10 May 1994).The Department of Justice and Constitutional Development will solicit contributions from relevant stakeholders (public and private) in order to secure adequate resources to bring about holistic interventions in these 128 communities, identified by the TRC on a case by case basis that might differ in value but to a maximum value of R30 million.
tgt: Ukufezekiswa Kwemiklamo Yokuhlunyeleliswa Komphakathi kuzolungisa ukungalingani kwasemandulo ngokuhlunyeleliswa kwemiphakathi eyi-128 eyayivuleleke ezenzweni zodlame kanye nokubhidlizwa ngesikhathi sokungqubuzana (1 Ndasa 1960 -10 Nhlaba 1994).UMnyango Wezobulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo uzocela izinkokhelo kubabambiqhaza abafanelekile (abakuhulumeni nabazimele) ukuze uzothola izinsiza ezanele zokuza nemingenelelo ephelele kule miphakathi eyi-128, ehlonzwe yi-TRC ngamunye ngamunye nokungenzeka izimo zayo zihluke ngokwenani kodwa lifinyelele enanini eliyizigidi ezingama-30 zamarandi isilinganiso esiphezulu.

src: This will ensure that Projects are feasible and sustainable in order to realise community aspirations.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi Imiklamo iyenzeka futhi iqinile ukuze kufezekiswe amaphupho omphakathi.
